name: avanan-mcp
description: Every Avanan (Check Point Harmony Email and Collaboration) API operation, plus shift-start triage, phishing campaign clustering, single-message lifecycle timelines, one exception lookup across all seven security engines, and cross-tenant MSP fleet rollups that a stateless API mirror cannot answer in a single call.

avanan_app_id.title: AVANAN_APP_ID
avanan_app_id.description: Sets AVANAN_APP_ID (the Avanan application ID) for the Avanan MCP server.

avanan_client_secret.title: AVANAN_CLIENT_SECRET
avanan_client_secret.description: Sets AVANAN_CLIENT_SECRET (the Avanan client secret) for the Avanan MCP server.

avanan_token.title: Avanan API token
avanan_token.description: Bearer token for the Avanan Smart API. Minted from your Avanan client ID and secret by `auth login`, or pasted here directly.

avanan_base_url.title: Avanan API base URL
avanan_base_url.description: Base URL for the Avanan API. Leave the prefilled default unless your account uses a different regional or self-hosted host.

avanan_user_agent.title: User-Agent header
avanan_user_agent.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on Avanan requests. Leave blank to use the CLI's own built-in User-Agent.

printing_press_client_profile.title: Client profile
printing_press_client_profile.description: Binds this MCP server to one tenant-gated client profile, so every call answers for that customer. Leave blank to use the profile configured as default_client_profile.

avanan_mcp_read_only.title: Read-only MCP mode
avanan_mcp_read_only.description: Optional. Set to exactly 1 to expose only read-only tools and refuse any state-changing execute call. Leave blank to keep every tool available.

avanan_no_local_data.title: Run without a local copy
avanan_no_local_data.description: Optional. Set to 1 to keep no local copy of API responses: reads go to the API and the response cache is off. Leave blank to keep the local store.

avanan_mcp_http_token.title: MCP HTTP transport bearer token
avanan_mcp_http_token.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (a remote/hosted deployment). Callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transport that Claude Desktop uses.
